parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: Только английский. Лучшая модель для англоговорящих.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Очень быстрая, только английский. Хорошо справляется с акцентами.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Быстрая, только английский. Хороший баланс скорости и точности.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Оптимизирована для тайваньского мандаринского. Поддержка переключения языков.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Очень быстрая. Китайский, английский, японский, корейский, кантонский.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Распознавание русской речи. Быстро и точно.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Очень быстрая. Английский, немецкий, испанский, французский. Поддержка перевода.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Точная многоязычная. 25 европейских языков. Поддержка перевода.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: Большая, медленная, но очень точная многоязычная модель.

microphone.description: Необходим для прослушивания вашего голоса для транскрипции.

accessibility.description: Необходим для ввода расшифрованного текста в ваши приложения.

models.openPluginsFolderLoaded_other: Open the architecture plugins folder ({{count}} external plugins loaded)

transcribe.description: Сочетание клавиш для записи и транскрибирования вашего голоса.

cancel.name: Горячая клавиша отмены
cancel.description: Сочетание клавиш для отмены текущей записи.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Горячая клавиша постобработки
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Специальное сочетание клавиш для ИИ-постобработки вашей транскрипции.

multi_stt_transcribe.name: Multi STT Shortcut
multi_stt_transcribe.description: Keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe with multiple STT models

errors.reset: Не удалось сбросить ярлык до исходного значения
errors.unsupportedCombo: {{combo}} can't be simulated: use at least one non-modifier key from letters, digits, space, enter, tab, esc, arrows or F1–F24

language.title: Язык
language.description: Выберите язык для распознавания речи. «Авто» автоматически определит язык, а выбор конкретного языка может повысить точность определения этого языка.

shortcutActivation.title: Поведение сочетания клавиш
shortcutActivation.description: Выберите, как горячая клавиша транскрипции запускает и останавливает запись.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Удерживайте для записи или нажмите кратко для переключения
descriptions.toggle: Нажмите сочетание клавиш, чтобы начать запись, нажмите ещё раз, чтобы остановить

channel.title: Входной канал
channel.description: Выберите входной канал для записи. Используйте эту настройку, если у вашего аудиоинтерфейса несколько входов.

audioFeedback.label: Обратная звуковая связь
audioFeedback.description: Воспроизведение звука при запуске и остановке записи

outputDevice.title: Устройство вывода
outputDevice.description: Выберите предпочитаемое устройство вывода звука для звуков обратной связи

experimentalToggle.label: Экспериментальные функции
experimentalToggle.description: Включить экспериментальные функции, которые находятся в разработке.

lazyStreamClose.label: Оставлять микрофон включённым между транскрипциями
lazyStreamClose.description: Оставляет поток микрофона открытым в течение 30 секунд после остановки записи, уменьшая задержку при последовательных транскрипциях. Может ухудшить качество звука Bluetooth.

transcribe.title: Ускорение Whisper
transcribe.description: Аппаратное ускорение для моделей Whisper. Автоматический режим использует GPU при наличии (Metal на macOS, Vulkan на Windows/Linux).

startHidden.label: Скрыть при запуске
startHidden.description: Запускать в системный трей, не открывая окно.

autostart.label: Запускать при старте
autostart.description: Автоматически запускать Handy при входе в систему.

showTrayIcon.label: Показать значок в трее
showTrayIcon.description: Отображать значок Handy в системном трее.

style.title: Наложение
style.description: Выберите наложение при записи: «Нет» скрывает его, «Минимальное» показывает компактный индикатор, «В реальном времени» показывает транскрипцию по мере речи (только модели с поддержкой потоковой обработки — ищите значок «Потоковый» в списке моделей). В Linux рекомендуется «Нет».

position.title: Позиция индикатора
position.description: Отображение индикатора визуальной обратной связи во время записи и транскрипции. В Linux рекомендуется выбрать «Нет».

directMode.label: Direct Streaming
directMode.description: Reveal streaming transcription character-by-character as you speak for an instant typing feel.

directSpeed.label: Direct Streaming Speed
directSpeed.description: Speed at which characters appear during direct live streaming (in characters per second).

pasteMethod.title: Метод вставки
pasteMethod.description: Выбрать способ вставки текста. Прямой: имитирует набор текста через системный ввод. Нет: пропуск вставки, обновление только истории/буфера обмена.

directStreamingSpeed.label: Direct Streaming Speed
directStreamingSpeed.description: Speed at which characters are typed directly into the active application (in characters per second).

typingTool.title: Инструмент ввода
typingTool.description: Выберите, какой инструмент ввода в Linux использовать для метода прямой вставки. Auto автоматически определит и использует лучший доступный инструмент для вашей системы.

clipboardHandling.title: Обработка буфера обмена
clipboardHandling.description: Функция «Не изменять буфер обмена» сохраняет текущее содержимое буфера обмена после транскрипции. Копировать в буфер обмена оставляет результат транскрипции в буфере обмена после вставки.

autoSubmit.title: Автоматическая отправка
autoSubmit.description: Автоматически отправляет выбранную комбинацию клавиш после вставки текста. Cmd+Enter применяется на macOS, а Windows/Linux используют Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Перевести на английский
translateToEnglish.description: Автоматически переводить речь с других языков на английский во время транскрипции.

modelUnload.title: Выгрузить модель
modelUnload.description: Автоматически освобождать память, если модель не использовалась в течение указанного времени.

customWords.title: Пользовательский словарь
customWords.description: Помогите поддерживаемым моделям распознавать имена и специализированные термины. Нечёткая коррекция сейчас доступна только для слов, содержащих буквы A–Z и цифры.

noiseSuppression.title: Noise suppression (RNNoise)
noiseSuppression.description: Clean the microphone signal with RNNoise before voice detection and transcription. Helps with fans, keyboards and room hum; leave it off if your voice sounds processed or clipped. Applies immediately — use the live VAD test below to compare.

strength.label: Suppression strength
strength.description: Wet/dry mix of RNNoise's output and the untouched microphone. 100% is the suppressor alone; lower values let some of the original back in when voices start to sound processed.

vadThreshold.label: Suppression gate
vadThreshold.description: RNNoise's own speech probability below which a frame is muted entirely. Off passes everything the suppressor leaves; higher values cut more background between words.

vadGrace.label: Gate hold
vadGrace.description: How long audio keeps passing after the last frame above the gate threshold, so word endings and short pauses are not clipped.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Определение голосовой активности
voiceActivityDetection.description: Отфильтровывает тишину из записей. Модели с поддержкой потоковой обработки используют более длинный «хвост» VAD; отключение VAD записывает необработанный звук.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Удалять слова-паразиты
fillerWordRemoval.description: Удаляет распространённые слова-заминки из расшифровок. Отключите, чтобы сохранить их.

micIdleTimeout.title: Mic Idle Timeout
micIdleTimeout.infiniteDescription: When enabled, the microphone stream stays open forever until manually closed. Disable to set a custom timeout duration.
micIdleTimeout.timeoutDescription: How long to keep the mic open after a recording stops before closing it.
micIdleTimeout.unitDescription: Seconds or minutes for the timeout value.

saveRawAudio.label: Save Raw Uncompressed Audio
saveRawAudio.description: Saves recordings in their native microphone sample rate and bit depth without downsampling or silence removal.

speechStats.title: Speech Stats in Overlay
speechStats.description: Show live speech statistics in the recording overlay: whether you are speaking or paused, a timer that counts only while you are actually talking, and your running average words per minute. Words per minute needs a streaming-capable model, since it is measured from the live transcription.

pauseHold.label: Pause Tolerance
pauseHold.description: How long silence must last before the speech timer stops counting. Shorter gaps are treated as part of the same sentence, so the timer does not stall between words.

vadSensitivity.label: VAD Threshold
vadSensitivity.description: Speech probability a frame needs to count as speech. Lower values are more sensitive and keep quiet or distant speech (and more noise); higher values cut more background noise but may clip soft words. Default 0.50.

vadLiveTest.title: Live VAD test
vadLiveTest.description: Open the microphone and watch the detector decide frame by frame, without loading any model. Nothing is transcribed or saved. Move the VAD Threshold slider above while you talk until normal speech reads as Speech and background noise stays Silence.
vadLiveTest.hint: Talk normally, then pause. The bar should cross the marker while you talk and stay below it when you stop; the grey tick is the recent peak. Audio kept shows what a model would actually hear after smoothing.
vadLiveTest.errorStart: Could not start the VAD test: {{error}}

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence недоступен на этом устройстве. Требуется Apple Silicon Mac под управлением macOS Tahoe (26.0) или более поздней версии с включенным Apple Intelligence в настройках системы.

baseUrl.title: Базовый URL
baseUrl.description: Базовый URL-адрес API для выбранного провайдера. Редактировать можно только настраиваемого поставщика.

model.title: Модель
model.descriptionCustom: Укажите идентификатор модели, ожидаемый вашей пользовательской конечной точкой.

prompts.title: Запрос к модели

selectedPrompt.title: Выберите запрос
selectedPrompt.description: Выберите запрос для постобработки транскрипции или создайте новый. Используйте ${output} внутри текста запроса для ссылки на записанную транскрипцию.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Напишите инструкции для постобработки транскрипции. Например: Улучшить грамматику и ясность следующего текста: ${output}
prompts.selectToEdit: Выберите запрос выше, чтобы просмотреть и изменить его сведения.
prompts.createFirst: Нажмите «Создать новый запрос» выше, чтобы создать первый запрос для постобработки.

history.title: История
history.empty: Транскрипций пока нет. Начните запись, чтобы создать свою историю!
history.deleteError: Не удалось удалить запись. Пожалуйста, попробуйте еще раз.
history.retranscribeError: Не удалось перетранскрибировать. Пожалуйста, попробуйте снова.
history.transcriptionFailed: Транскрипция не удалась. Вы можете перетранскрибировать, используя значок повтора.
history.deleteRecordingsConfirmMessage: Are you sure you want to delete all audio recordings and clear your transcription history? This action cannot be undone.
history.deleteRecordingsSuccess: All recordings and history have been deleted.
history.deleteRecordingsError: Failed to delete recordings. Please try again.
history.noMatch: No transcriptions match your filter criteria.

liveLogs.title: Журнал в реальном времени
liveLogs.description: Просмотр журналов приложения в реальном времени для диагностики проблем без открытия файла журнала. Отображаются только записи, созданные пока эта панель открыта; учитывает настройку «Уровень журнала» выше.
liveLogs.empty: Ожидание журналов… Записи появятся здесь, как только приложение их создаст.

updateChecks.label: Проверять наличие обновлений
updateChecks.description: Автоматически проверять наличие новых версий Handy

soundTheme.label: Звуковая тема
soundTheme.description: Выберите звуковую тему для начала и остановки записи обратной связи.

historyLimit.title: Размер истории
historyLimit.description: Максимальное количество записей истории, которые можно сохранить

recordingRetention.title: Автоматическое удаление записей
recordingRetention.description: Автоматически удалять старые записи для экономии места

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Всегда включенный микрофон
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Держите микрофон активным для более быстрого ответа

clamshellMicrophone.title: Раскладной микрофон
clamshellMicrophone.description: Микрофон для использования при закрытой крышке ноутбука

postProcessingToggle.label: Постобработка
postProcessingToggle.description: Включить уточнение текста с помощью искусственного интеллекта после транскрипции

muteWhileRecording.label: Отключить звук во время записи
muteWhileRecording.description: Отключение звука системы во время записи

keyboardImplementation.title: Реализация клавиатуры
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Клавиатурные сочетания были несовместимы и сброшены к значениям по умолчанию

pasteDelay.title: Задержка вставки (до)
pasteDelay.description: Задержка (в миллисекундах) после копирования текста, перед отправкой нажатия клавиши вставки. Увеличьте, если ничего не вставляется.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Задержка вставки (после)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Задержка (в миллисекундах) после нажатия клавиши вставки, перед восстановлением предыдущего буфера обмена. Увеличьте, если вместо транскрипции вставляется старое содержимое буфера обмена.

holdThreshold.title: Порог удержания
holdThreshold.description: Только для автоматического режима: сколько (в миллисекундах) нужно удерживать сочетание клавиш, чтобы это считалось удержанием, а не кратким нажатием. Уменьшите, если после короткого удержания запись продолжается; увеличьте, если намеренные краткие нажатия воспринимаются как удержание.

reliablePaste.title: Надёжная вставка (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Восстанавливать буфер обмена только после того, как целевое приложение действительно прочитает транскрипцию, а не по фиксированной задержке. Предназначено для устранения вставки старого содержимого буфера обмена при нагрузке на систему. Требуется метод вставки через буфер обмена; только macOS и Windows.

recordingBuffer.title: Дополнительный буфер записи
recordingBuffer.description: Дополнительное время (в миллисекундах) для продолжения записи после отпускания клавиши, чтобы захватить завершающий звук. 0 = без дополнительного буфера.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Диагностика клавиатуры
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Проверяет, доходят ли события клавиатуры до Handy. Записывается только количество событий — никогда то, какие клавиши вы нажимаете.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Прослушивание… нажмите своё сочетание клавиш несколько раз (например, Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input блокирует события клавиш — сочетания с обычной клавишей не смогут работать, пока это не будет устранено.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: События модификаторов приходят, а события клавиш — нет: что-то подавляет клавиши, хотя Secure Input отмечен как выключенный. Пожалуйста, сообщите об этом на GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: События клавиш доходят до Handy нормально.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: События не зафиксированы — вы нажимали клавиши во время теста?

whatsNewPreview.title: Предпросмотр новинок
whatsNewPreview.description: Открыть последние встроенные примечания к выпуску, не отмечая их как просмотренные
whatsNewPreview.noNotes: Встроенные примечания к выпуску не найдены
whatsNewPreview.error: Не удалось показать предварительный просмотр примечаний к выпуску

onboardingPreview.title: Предпросмотр первоначальной настройки
onboardingPreview.description: Просмотрите экраны первоначальной настройки, не изменяя разрешения, модели или статус завершения

appendTrailingNewline.label: Append Trailing New Line
appendTrailingNewline.description: Add a newline after pasted transcription

sessionToasts.title: Recent errors and warnings ({{count}})
sessionToasts.description: Every error or warning toast shown since the app started, newest first, so one that disappeared can still be read and copied.

filters.errorsDescription: Include error toasts in the list.
filters.warningsDescription: Include warning toasts in the list.

sessionToasts.empty: No errors or warnings this session.

interfaceScale.label: Interface scale
interfaceScale.description: Zoom the whole window (70–160 %). Use it when the OS display scaling makes Handy too small or too large; the minimum window size stays the same.

appDataDirectory.title: Каталог данных приложения
appDataDirectory.description: Место, где Handy хранит свои данные

sourceCode.title: Исходный код
sourceCode.description: Просмотреть исходный код и внести свой вклад

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: Высокопроизводительная модель автоматического распознавания речи OpenAI Whisper
ggml.details: Handy использует ggml для быстрого локального преобразования речи в текст. Спасибо великолепной работе Георгия Герганова и участников.

rnnoise.title: RNNoise / nnnoiseless
rnnoise.details: Optional microphone noise suppression uses nnnoiseless, a Rust port of Xiph's RNNoise (BSD-3-Clause). Thanks to Jean-Marc Valin and Joe Neeman.

whatsNewUpdates.label: Показывать новинки
whatsNewUpdates.description: Показывать примечания к выпуску после обновлений Handy

statistics.title: Transcription Statistics
statistics.description: Review transcription volume, aggregate audio duration, and end-to-end latency.

wpm.title: Speech Rate
wpm.description: Calculated from total words divided by silence-filtered speech duration.

transcription.title: Transcription Latency
transcription.description: Time elapsed from stopping input until raw transcription text is produced.

postProcessing.title: Post-Processing Latency
postProcessing.description: Time elapsed while LLM polishing is executed.
postProcessing.unavailable: No post-processed transcriptions in this range.

reset.title: Reset Statistics
reset.description: Clear all accumulated transcription metrics and latency records.
reset.historyUnaffected: Transcription history and audio files will remain intact.

dialog.title: Reset Transcription Statistics
dialog.description: Are you sure you want to reset all transcription statistics? This action cannot be undone.
dialog.warning: This will permanently delete all metric records. Your history log is unaffected.

loading.title: Loading statistics...
loading.description: Aggregating metrics for the selected range.

empty.title: No transcription statistics yet
empty.description: Record audio using the transcription hotkey to start tracking metrics.

fileTranscription.description: Turn recordings into text files. Add files or whole folders, pick how they should be transcribed, and Handy writes a .txt or .md next to each recording or into a folder of your choice.

dropZone.title: Drop audio files or folders here, or click to browse
dropZone.subtitle: Files are queued in order; long recordings are split at quiet points automatically.

mode.title: Transcription mode
mode.description: Which pipeline each file goes through. Post-processing uses the prompt and provider from the Post Process page; Multi-STT uses the extra models and merge prompt from the Multi STT page.

post_process.label: STT + Post-process
post_process.description: Selected model, then the post-processing prompt.

multi_stt.label: Multi-STT
multi_stt.description: All Multi-STT models, merged with the merge prompt (concatenated if no prompt is set).

multi_stt_post_process.label: Multi-STT + Post-process
multi_stt_post_process.description: Multi-STT merge, then the post-processing prompt.

warnings.postProcessDisabled: Post-processing is turned off. Enable it on the Advanced page (Experimental) and configure a provider, model and prompt, or the text is saved unprocessed.
warnings.multiSttNoModels: Multi-STT is off or has no extra models selected. Only the primary model will run; set up extra models on the Multi STT page.

outputFolder.title: Output folder
outputFolder.description: Where transcripts are written. By default each transcript is saved next to its audio file with the same name.

format.title: Output format
format.description: Plain text, or Markdown with a small header (file name, mode, model, date).

overwrite.label: Overwrite existing transcripts
overwrite.description: Replace an existing transcript with the same name. When off, a -2, -3, … suffix is added instead.

subfolders.label: Include sub-folders
subfolders.description: When a folder is added, also queue the audio files inside its sub-folders.

segmentMinutes.label: Maximum segment length
segmentMinutes.description: Long recordings are transcribed in segments of at most this length, cut at the quietest point near the boundary, so a single file never holds the model for an hour at a time.

errors.noFiles: Add audio files or a folder to get started.
errors.nothingAdded: Nothing to add: no supported audio files found ({{formats}}).
errors.emptyFolder: That folder contains no supported audio files.

liveMode.title: Live Mode
liveMode.description: Keep listening and record everything: the raw microphone signal is saved in chunked WAV files while the live transcription is written into a text file as you speak. Needs a streaming-capable model.

model.label: Model: {{model}}
model.notStreaming: {{model}} does not support live streaming. Pick a streaming-capable model (for example a Whisper or Parakeet GGUF) in the footer to use Live Mode.
model.none: No model selected. Pick a streaming-capable model in the footer to use Live Mode.

transcript.title: Transcript
transcript.empty: The transcript appears here as you speak and is written to the file at the same time.

outputFolder.title: Output folder
outputFolder.description: Each session gets its own sub-folder (live_<date>_<time>) with the transcript and the audio chunks.

chunkMinutes.label: Chunk length
chunkMinutes.description: Target length of one audio file and one transcript segment. The next chunk starts immediately, so nothing is lost between chunks.

format.title: Transcript format
format.description: Plain text, or Markdown with a session header and one paragraph per chunk.

granularity.title: Write to file
granularity.description: How the live text grows in the file. Character by character mirrors the stream exactly, including the model's tentative tail; word by word only writes completed words.

character.label: Character by character
character.description: Mirror the live stream, tentative text included.

word.label: Word by word
word.description: Only write words once they are complete.

saveAudio.label: Save audio chunks
saveAudio.description: Write the raw microphone signal (native sample rate and bit depth) to chunk_0001.wav, chunk_0002.wav, … in the session folder.

silenceBoundary.label: Cut chunks on a pause
silenceBoundary.description: Once a chunk reaches 80 % of its length, end it on the first pause instead of exactly at the limit, so a cut never lands in the middle of a word.

sessions.title: Previous sessions
sessions.description: Session folders found in the output folder, newest first.

overlay.hiddenNote: The overlay is off. Choose Minimal or Live above to configure what it shows.

scope.title: Analyser
scope.description: The picture of the microphone the overlay draws while you record: a spectrum and a trace of the raw audio, both computed with the Live FFT page's analysis settings.

showSpectrum.label: Show spectrum
showSpectrum.description: Draw the spectrum view in the overlay.

style.label: Spectrum style
style.description: Filled area, a line, or bars.

mirror.label: Mirror spectrum
mirror.description: Draw the spectrum rising from the centre line with its negative mirrored below it, so it reads like the centred waveform beside it.

peakHold.label: Peak hold
peakHold.description: Keep a slowly falling marker at each column's recent peak, as the Live FFT page's peak hold does.

showWave.label: Show waveform
showWave.description: Draw the raw audio trace in the overlay.

waveSamples.label: Waveform length
waveSamples.description: How many samples of raw audio the trace covers, at the analysed signal's rate (4096 is 85 ms at 48 kHz). Longer windows show more of the phrase and move slower.

waveTaper.label: Edge fade
waveTaper.description: Samples faded to zero at each end of the window, so the trace never starts or ends mid-swing.

gainFloor.label: Auto-gain floor
gainFloor.description: The trace is scaled to the loudest recent swing, but never below this level, so room tone is not blown up to full height.

viewWidth.label: View width
viewWidth.description: Width of each view; the pill and the overlay window grow with it.

viewHeight.label: View height
viewHeight.description: Height of the views; above 22 px the control row grows to fit.

scope.analysisNote: Scale, window, EQ, weighting, dB range, ballistics and update rate are the Live FFT page's settings.

liveFft.title: Live FFT
liveFft.description: Real-time spectrum of the microphone with a full analyser parameter set: psychoacoustic frequency scales, shelving EQ, window and equal-loudness weighting, dB references and attack/release ballistics — plus a peak-hold analyser and a waterfall.
liveFft.hotkeysNote: While the analyser runs the dictation hotkeys report "Already recording" and the cancel hotkey stops it. Nothing is transcribed or saved.

stopReason.cancelled: The analyser stopped because the recording was ended elsewhere (cancel hotkey or tray).
stopReason.window_hidden: The analyser stopped after two minutes with the window hidden, so the microphone is not held for nothing.

canvas.idle: Start the analyser to see the spectrum

presets.title: Presets
presets.description: Start from a known configuration; every parameter below stays editable. The source and threading choices are kept.

spectrum.title: Spectrum

source.label: Source
source.description: Which signal is analysed: the microphone at its native rate (full bandwidth, before noise suppression) or the 16 kHz frames a model hears (after resampling and noise suppression, before the VAD).
source.processedHint: What the model hears; 8 kHz bandwidth
source.denoisedHint: RNNoise's output at full bandwidth; the untouched microphone while suppression is off

scale.label: Scale
scale.description: Frequency axis of the spectrum: logarithmic, Mel, ERB, Bark, chroma (pitch classes), linear, or a Mel + Log blend.

warpInterp.label: Warp interpolation
warpInterp.description: How the linear FFT bins are resampled onto the perceptual grid. Cubic (Catmull-Rom, 4 taps) is smoother, so a 16K FFT with cubic looks like 32K with linear at half the cost.

spectrum.nyquistNote: Clamped to the Nyquist frequency of the source ({{hz}}).

outputBins.label: Output bins
outputBins.description: Size of the warped spectrum sent to the page per frame. More bins mean finer detail and a larger event; 1024 already exceeds the width of the display.

logFloor.label: Log floor Hz
logFloor.description: Lowest frequency of the Log and Mel + Log grids.

windowMode.label: Window length mode
windowMode.description: Set the analysis window in samples or in milliseconds (independent of the sample rate).

windowSamples.label: Window samples
windowSamples.description: Analysis window in samples (3175 = 72 ms at 44.1 kHz). Longer windows resolve closer frequencies but react more slowly.

fftSize.label: Zero-pad length
fftSize.description: Transform length. The window is centred in a zero-padded frame of this size (grown to the next power of two above the window when that is larger); a longer transform interpolates the spectrum more finely.

eq.title: EQ
eq.description: RBJ shelving EQ applied to new samples as they arrive, stateful and in time order — before the window and the transform.

enable.label: EQ enable
enable.description: Off skips the EQ code entirely.

highCutoff.label: High cutoff Hz
highCutoff.description: Corner frequency of the high shelf.

lowCutoff.label: Low cutoff Hz
lowCutoff.description: Corner frequency of the low shelf.

amount.label: EQ blend amount
amount.description: Wet/dry blend: 0 = dry, 1 = the filtered signal, above 1 exaggerates the change.

type.label: Window type
type.description: Taper applied to the analysis window before the transform.

kaiserBeta.label: Kaiser beta
kaiserBeta.description: Higher beta lowers the side lobes and widens the main lobe.

magnitudeNorm.label: Magnitude normalization
magnitudeNorm.description: Coherent gain keeps the window's mean at 1; full scale makes a sine of amplitude 1 read 1.0.

mode.label: Loudness mode
mode.description: Linear magnitude, decibels, or decibels mapped onto 0…1 over the dB range.

dbReference.label: dB reference
dbReference.description: What 0 dB means: the loudest bin of the frame, digital full scale, or a slow peak follower.

dbRange.label: dB range floor
dbRange.description: How many dB below the reference the display floor sits.

ballistics.label: Ballistics enable
ballistics.description: Asymmetric attack / release smoothing of the spectrum over time. Off skips the code entirely.

ballisticsMode.label: Ballistics mode
ballisticsMode.description: Per-frame coefficients or time constants in milliseconds, independent of the update rate.

attackMs.label: Attack ms
attackMs.description: Time to reach 63 % of a rise.

releaseMs.label: Release ms
releaseMs.description: Time to fall 63 % of a drop.

reset.label: Reset
reset.description: Clears the ballistics, AGC and EQ state.

performance.title: Performance

async.label: Async analysis (worker thread)
async.description: On: the transform runs on its own thread and the audio thread only copies samples into a ring. Off: the transform runs inline on the audio consumer thread. Changing this restarts a running analysis.

updateRate.label: Update rate
updateRate.description: Spectrum frames per second sent to the page.

performance.note: Handy analyses one channel: the selected input channel or the average of all (see General → Input channel). Settings apply as soon as they change, and FFT plans are cached per size.

voice.title: Voice detection & noise suppression
voice.description: Tune the speech detector and RNNoise while watching the spectrum. With the source set to the 16 kHz frames a model hears, the spectrum shows what noise suppression removes.

show.label: Show voice detection
show.description: Run the speech detector on the analysed signal and show its verdict frame by frame. Changing this restarts a running analysis.

voice.idle: Start the analyser to see the detector.
voice.sourceHint: The spectrum shows the untouched microphone. Analyse the signal after noise suppression to see what RNNoise removes.

server.title: Server
server.description: The llama.cpp server Handy supervises. It runs detached (no console window), is stopped with Handy, and its output is kept below.
server.useForPostProcessingDescription: Point the Custom LLM provider at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1 with the alias as model, and select it. Turn post-processing on in Post Process afterwards if it is off.
server.appliedToast: Post-processing now targets the local server on port {{port}}.
server.startOnDemandDescription: When a post-processing or merge request targets this server and it is not running, start it and wait for it to be ready (up to three minutes).
server.autostartDescription: Launch the server in the background when Handy starts, so the first request never waits for a model load.
server.stopOnExitDescription: Off keeps the server (and the GPU memory it holds) alive after Handy exits.
server.logsDescription: The last 400 lines of llama-server's output.

backend.title: llama.cpp build
backend.description: Which llama-server binary runs. Install a release here (the same GitHub assets the download script fetched) or use a folder you already have.
backend.detectNone: No existing llama.cpp folder found in the usual places.
backend.preferredDescription: Asset to install: auto picks CUDA when nvidia-smi reports it (detected: {{detected}}), otherwise CPU. Channel: latest build, stable releases only, or nightly builds only.
backend.releasesDescription: The newest llama.cpp build of the selected channel from github.com/ggml-org/llama.cpp (cached for ten minutes). A CUDA build is about 180 MB; the optional cudart package adds about 500 MB.
backend.installedDescription: Builds installed by Handy under its data folder.
backend.includeCudartFound: Off: CUDA toolkit {{version}} found at {{dir}} — it provides cudart / cuBLAS, so a CUDA build only needs its own ~180 MB.
backend.includeCudartMissing: No CUDA toolkit found (checked CUDA_PATH, every CUDA_PATH_V*, PATH and the default install folder). A CUDA build needs the ~500 MB cudart / cuBLAS package to run; turn this on before installing, or install the NVIDIA CUDA toolkit.
backend.removeRuntimeTitle: Delete the bundled cudart / cuBLAS DLLs from this install. Only safe when the CUDA toolkit is installed.
backend.includeCudartOffPath: That folder is not on PATH; Handy adds it for llama-server when it starts it.
backend.includeCudartNoCublas: cuBLAS was not found next to it — turn this on, the server needs cublas64 and cublasLt64 too.

model.title: Model files
model.description: GGUF files for the server. Files next to the chosen model are listed for the pickers; any path can be typed or browsed.
model.draftDescription: Speculative decoding draft (mtp-*.gguf). Adds --model-draft with --spec-type draft-mtp; the fastest configuration measured for the merge and clean prompts.
model.mmprojDescription: Multimodal projector. Only loaded when the toggle below is on.
model.mmprojEnabledDescription: Off saves about 1 GB of VRAM and a little speed; text post-processing does not need it.

command.title: Command line
command.description: Defaults reproduce the launch script: 8k context, all layers on the GPU, flash attention, sampling tuned for the merge/clean prompts (temp 0.05, top-p 0.35), reasoning off, MTP draft with 4 tokens.
command.previewDescription: Restart the server after changing anything here.
command.portDescription: The provider base URL is http://127.0.0.1:<port>/v1.
command.context_sizeDescription: Tokens of context. 8192 covers long transcripts with room for the prompt.
command.gpu_layersDescription: -1 puts every layer on the GPU.
command.top_kDescription: Sampling: keep the k most likely tokens.
command.spec_draft_n_maxDescription: Tokens the MTP draft proposes per step. 4 in the script.
command.aliasDescription: Model name the server answers to; the provider sends it as the model.
command.reasoningDescription: --reasoning on. Off is much faster and what the cleanup prompts expect.
command.attnRotDescription: Environment flag that measured +3–4 % on short prompts.
command.customArgsDescription: When not empty, replaces everything after llama-server. Use the preview above as a starting point.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Портативные установки нельзя обновить автоматически. Скачайте ниже установщик для вашей системы, запустите его и установите в ту же папку — папка Data/ (настройки, модели, записи) останется на месте.

enabled.label: Enable Multi STT
enabled.description: Run multiple speech-to-text models simultaneously and merge their results

models.title: Additional Models
models.model2Description: Select a second STT model to run alongside the primary model
models.model3Description: Select a third STT model to run alongside the primary model
models.languageNotApplicable: This model does not support language selection
models.model4Description: Select a fourth STT model to run alongside the primary model

mergePrompt.title: Merge Prompt
mergePrompt.description: Configure how the multiple transcriptions are merged
mergePrompt.promptPlaceholder: Enter instructions for merging the transcriptions...
mergePrompt.promptTip: Use {{output}} for the primary model, {{output2}} for the second model, and {{output3}} for the third model
mergePrompt.noPrompt: Without a merge prompt, outputs will be concatenated

streamingFirst.title: Experimental: streaming 1st model
streamingFirst.enabledLabel: Stream the rough text while you speak
streamingFirst.enabledDescription: The primary model's live stream becomes the 1st output and you watch it form, including everything you have said earlier in the session. Each time you stop speaking for longer than the pause below, the extra models re-transcribe that part of the audio and the merge prompt replaces its rough text in place.
streamingFirst.pauseDescription: How long you have to stop speaking before the extra models re-run over what you just said. Several sentences between two pauses are re-run together, as one chunk, so they keep their context; a pause in the middle of a sentence only polishes the text so far and that sentence keeps accumulating.
streamingFirst.contextLabel: Previous sentences re-run with the new ones
streamingFirst.contextDescription: How many sentences you have already spoken are handed to the extra models together with the new audio. They then hear the whole join, so a sentence that was ended at a pause and then continued can be put back together, and the audio that gets re-transcribed stays the same size however long you have been talking. 0 hands over only what is new.
streamingFirst.maxSentencesDescription: Close the chunk at a sentence end once it holds this many sentences, even if you have not paused, so a long stretch of speech is still corrected in pieces of a predictable size. 0 waits for a pause; the 60-second limit still applies.
streamingFirst.note: Needs a streaming-capable primary model and a merge prompt; without either, Multi-STT runs as usual. The 1st slot is the streaming model's own live text. With the Direct Streaming paste method the text is typed into the app as it forms and each merge retypes the part it corrected.
streamingFirst.chunkFailedTitle: A chunk could not be merged
streamingFirst.chunkFailedToast: Chunk {{chunk}} failed to merge, so its text is the models' outputs side by side. The next pause retries it.

keepModelsLoaded.label: Keep Extra Models Loaded
keepModelsLoaded.description: Keep the 2nd, 3rd, and 4th models in memory between multi-STT uses for faster subsequent transcriptions (uses more memory)

performanceMode.title: Performance Mode
performanceMode.fullPowerDescription: Shortcut to simulate when Multi-STT recording finishes and audio is sent to models
performanceMode.normalModeDescription: Shortcut to simulate after the LLM merge succeeds, or after paste if the LLM doesn't respond

enabled.label: Enable Performance Mode
enabled.description: Automatically toggle performance mode during Multi-STT transcription

triggerOnStart.label: Trigger Performance Mode at 1st Keybind
triggerOnStart.description: Trigger the Full Power shortcut immediately upon starting Multi-STT recording instead of waiting until recording ends

accentColor.title: Accent Color
accentColor.description: Choose a custom color for the interface, logos, and recording overlay

hotkeySidebar.title: Your shortcuts
hotkeySidebar.configureHint: Click a shortcut to change it.

empty.title: No shortcut set yet
empty.message: Handy has no transcription hotkey until you pick one, so nothing happens when you press keys. Choose one in General.

quickHelp.general: Pick the shortcut you hold or tap to dictate, the microphone Handy listens to, and the sounds it plays.
quickHelp.history: Every transcription is kept here with its audio. Re-run it with another mode, copy it, or save the ones worth keeping.
quickHelp.statistics: How much you dictate, how fast you speak, and how long transcription and post-processing take.
quickHelp.models: Download and switch the local speech model. Everything runs on this computer through transcribe.cpp; smaller models are faster, larger ones more accurate.
quickHelp.multiStt: Record once and transcribe with up to four models in parallel, then let a language model merge the outputs into one text.
quickHelp.fileTranscription: Turn audio files or whole folders into .txt or .md transcripts, with the same modes as live dictation.
quickHelp.liveMode: Keep the microphone open for as long as you like: the audio is saved in chunks and the transcript written to a file while you speak.
quickHelp.liveFft: A real-time spectrum analyser for the microphone: perceptual frequency scales, EQ, window, weighting, dB references, ballistics and a waterfall.
quickHelp.overlay: Everything about the recording overlay: whether and where it shows, how live text arrives, the speech statistics it carries, and the spectrum and waveform it draws.
quickHelp.advanced: Noise suppression, voice detection with a live test, paste behaviour, and the settings that trade latency for accuracy.
quickHelp.postprocessing: Send the transcript through a language model to clean it up, using a prompt you write, before it is pasted.
quickHelp.debug: Diagnostics: recent errors, log level, live logs, keyboard checks, and the timing knobs behind pasting.
quickHelp.llama: Run the llama.cpp server that post-processing and the Multi-STT merge talk to: install a build, pick the model files, tune the command, start it.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Handy turns speech into text on this computer and pastes it where you were typing. Pick a goal below, search, or read through the sections.
help.aboutLink: Version, licences and acknowledgments are on the About page.

search.noResults: Nothing matches. Try another word, or open the Debug page for diagnostics.

smartHelp.title: What do you want to do?

setup.label: Set up my microphone and shortcut
setup.description: Start dictating: pick a hotkey and a microphone.

model.label: Choose a model
model.description: Faster or more accurate, English-only or multilingual.

tune.label: Stop noise or clipped words
tune.description: Noise suppression, voice detection and the live test.

files.label: Transcribe recordings
files.description: Files, folders, or a long live session into a file.

broken.label: Something is not working
broken.description: Where to look first, and what to send with a bug report.

transcription.title: Press the shortcut. Speak. Text appears.
transcription.summary:
Set a Transcribe shortcut in General (a fresh install has none) and choose whether it toggles recording or works while held. Pick the microphone Handy listens to. When you stop, the text is pasted into the app you were using; the History page keeps a copy with the audio.

The right-edge tab shows the shortcuts that are currently assigned and jumps to the control that changes them.

models.title: Choose a local model.
models.summary: Every model runs on this computer through transcribe.cpp; nothing is sent anywhere. Smaller models answer faster, larger ones make fewer mistakes, and some are English-only while others handle many languages. Models marked as streaming can show text while you are still speaking (Live overlay, Live Mode). Download from the Models page; the first download is chosen during onboarding. Quantization variants trade a little accuracy for less memory, and the benchmark next to the quantization list measures them on your machine.

advanced.title: Advanced: paste behaviour and timing.
advanced.summary: How the text reaches the target app (clipboard paste, typing, or direct streaming while you speak), whether a space or newline is appended, filler-word removal and custom words, plus the microphone idle timeout and model unload timeout that trade memory for start-up speed.

vad.title: Noise suppression, voice detection and the live test.
vad.summary: Noise suppression (RNNoise) cleans the microphone signal before anything else hears it. Voice activity detection then drops the silent frames so the model only sees speech; the VAD Threshold slider sets how sure the detector must be. Press "Test with microphone" next to the slider: talk, then pause, and move the slider until normal speech shows as Speech and background noise stays Silence. The On/Off pill in the test toggles noise suppression so you can compare. Recordings with no detected speech are never sent to a model.

postProcessing.title: Let a language model clean up the transcript.
postProcessing.summary: With post-processing on, the transcript is sent to the language model provider you configure (a local server or an online API) with a prompt you write, and the polished result is pasted instead. A dedicated hotkey always applies it; the History page shows both the raw and the polished text.
postProcessing.warning: Online providers charge per request and need an API key. Never share the key, and set a spending limit at the provider.

multiStt.title: Multi-STT: several models, one transcript.
multiStt.summary: Record once with the Multi STT shortcut and up to four models transcribe the same audio in parallel. A merge prompt with ${output}, ${output2}… placeholders lets a language model combine them; without a prompt the outputs are simply listed. Performance mode can send a keyboard shortcut to an external power-profile tool while the models run.

fileTranscription.title: Transcribe files and folders.
fileTranscription.summary: Drop audio files (WAV, MP3, M4A, FLAC, OGG) or folders on the Transcribe Files page and choose a mode: plain, post-processed, Multi-STT, or both. Long files are cut at quiet points, and a .txt or .md is written next to each file or into a folder you choose.

liveMode.title: Live Mode: dictate for hours into a file.
liveMode.summary: Live Mode keeps the microphone open, saves the audio as numbered chunk files and mirrors the live transcript into a text file while you speak. It needs a streaming-capable model. The transcription hotkeys are paused while a session runs; the cancel hotkey ends the current chunk.

liveFft.title: Live FFT.
liveFft.summary: Live FFT opens the microphone and shows its spectrum in real time — bars, line or area with peak hold, plus a scrolling waterfall. The analysis parameters are grouped as Spectrum (scale, warp, window length, zero-pad length), EQ, Window & weighting, Loudness & ballistics and Performance. Presets give quick starting points, including a raw linear-magnitude preset. Nothing is transcribed or saved; the dictation hotkeys are paused while it runs and the cancel hotkey stops it.

overlay.title: The recording overlay.
overlay.summary: The Overlay page gathers the overlay's settings: style (none, minimal, live) and position, direct typing of the live text and its speed, the speech statistics, and the analyser it draws while you record. The analyser shows a spectrum and a trace of the raw microphone audio; choose which views to show, the spectrum style, how many samples the trace covers, how its ends fade, its auto-gain floor and the size of the views. The analysis itself (scale, window, EQ, weighting, dB range, ballistics, update rate) is configured on the Live FFT page and used as is.

history.title: History and Statistics.
history.summary: History lists every transcription with its audio, word count and speaking rate, and can re-run it with another mode. Statistics adds totals, streaks and latency distributions. Raw, unprocessed microphone audio can also be saved from Advanced → History.

troubleshooting.title: Something is not working.
troubleshooting.summary: Nothing happens on the hotkey: check that one is set in General and not used by another app. No text: open the Debug page (Ctrl+Shift+D) and look at recent errors and the live log. Words missing: lower the VAD Threshold or run the live test. Slow: pick a smaller model or a lighter quantization. When reporting a problem, include the log file from the Debug page and the model name.

llama.title: Local LLM: the brain behind post-processing and merging.
llama.summary: The Local LLM page runs llama.cpp for you. Install a build (CUDA, Vulkan or CPU) from the releases list or point Handy at a folder that already has llama-server, pick the model, its MTP draft and the optional mmproj, and press Start. The command line shown is exactly what runs. "Use for post-processing & merge" points the LLM provider at this server; with "Start when needed" on, the first post-process request starts it and waits. The status-bar brain shows Stopped / Starting / Ready / Error, next to the CPU, RAM, GPU and VRAM meters.

aiAssist.title: Ask an AI assistant
aiAssist.description: Copy this prompt into your favourite AI chat; it points the assistant at the source code so it can answer questions about how Handy behaves.
aiAssist.prompt: I am using Handy (Multi-STT fork), a local speech-to-text app. Its source is at {{url}}. Please read the README and AGENTS.md there before answering. My question:
